lines: The FY2025 audit opinion is qualified; basis of qualification as per the auditor: Recoverability of SAR 84.0m due from Al Sahel Logistics Services (a sister company classified doubtful by another bank and under litigation) could not be confirmed; no provision was made.

Due from related parties of SAR 84.0m is 44.9% of reported net worth of SAR 187.0m at FY2025 (PY 35.6%), against a threshold of 20%; the balance moved FY2023 SAR 46.0m, FY2024 SAR 64.0m, FY2025 SAR 84.0m.
After netting due from related parties of SAR 84.0m, adjusted net worth is SAR 103.0m and leverage (total liabilities / net worth) 3.88x at FY2025 (reported SAR 187.0m and 2.14x), against 3.00x.
Operating cash flow of SAR -6.0m against EBITDA of SAR 48.0m in FY2025: cash conversion -12.5% (PY 18.1%), against 50%; operating cash flow negative in 1 of 3 audited years.

The auditor changed from Qarar Audit (listed, clean opinion in FY2024) to Mizan & Partners Chartered Accountants (unlisted, qualified opinion in FY2025); the change coincides with a move off the approved panel or a qualified opinion.
